title: Case-level evaluator bundle identity
description: One immutable identity per case over the hidden evaluator assets: tests/, solution/, hidden reference inputs, thresholds, and frozen profile files. Formal-run manifests reference this digest instead of carrying a private copy of the evaluator.

evaluator_bundle_sha256.description: Alias of bundle_sha256 emitted by build_evaluator_manifest.py; formal-run manifests reference the evaluator identity under this key.
